facts.fact: National Bank of Ethiopia Directive ONPS/10/2025, issued under National Payment Systems Proclamation 718 as amended, entered into force on 12 May 2025.
The directive sets licensing, capital (Birr 100 million) and shareholding rules for payment instrument issuers, allowing telecom operators among the permitted large shareholders.

The directive requires payment instrument issuers to interoperate wallet-to-wallet through the national switch or another licensed switch operator, and all financial institutions providing digital financial services to participate in the national switch's instant payment system; in force 12 May 2025.
